values.meaning: decay duration of bonus move speed

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks and damaging ability hits against enemy champions grant Sivir bonus move speed that refreshes on subsequent hits.
mechanics.quote: '''Sivir's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} and {{tip|ability}} hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|changedisplay=true|55 to 75 for 5|1;6;11;16;18}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.

mechanics.claim: Fleet of Foot triggers even if the attack is dodged, blocked, misses due to blind, or is negated by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: ''Fleet of Foot'' will trigger even if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}} or misses due to {{tip|blind}} or if the ability is negated by a {{tip|spell shield}}.
